title: Conceding putts in stroke play
question: In stroke play, what happens if a player picks up their ball before holing out, thinking their score is already made?

choices.text: Their score for the hole is finished as it stands.
They must replace the ball, add one penalty stroke, and finish the hole.
They get a two-stroke penalty but do not replay the shot.
They are disqualified from the competition.

explanation: In stroke play, you must finish out the hole. If you pick up your ball before finishing, you need to put it back, add a penalty stroke, and finish the hole.
